item.content:encoded:
The Perfect Hotel in Mykonos

If you are looking for a perfect holiday experience with memories to cherish you are at the right place. Let’s plan a reasonable stay for you.
Book Your Stay Now
Surrounded by scenic beauty and attractive tourist attractions we make it convenient for you to visit all the beautiful places with our inhouse guide. We can also help you arrange transport facilities for an easier commute to nearby places.
Know More

Experience the Life of Mykonos City

We will help you experience Mykonos life in its true sense. From living among the residents to eating authentic delicacies you are sure to walk home with memories and wonderful moments.

Amenities & Facilities

If you are looking for a relaxing, refreshing and rejuvenating experience altogether, we offer all of that under one roof.

View All

An Infinite-edge Pool

Experience the joy of swimming in our infinity-edge pool that gives you a nice picturesque view.

Read More

An Iconic Spa

Set forth on an exquisite wellness journey to refresh, re-energize and rejuvenate at our iconic spa.

Read More

In-house Restaurants

We have three in-house restaurants offering different cuisines that you can choose from.

Read More

Our Inside Pictures

Take a look at some pretty pictures captured in and around our premises.

What Our Guests Say

We take pride in serving our guests with the best experience. Read what they say.

item.title: About-one
item.dc:creator: adminvivek
item.content:encoded:
EduMEasy: A Comprehensive Math-Lab for Schools

EduMEasy has developed a comprehensive Math-Lab for Schools to visualize and understand mathematics concepts through experiments. Our aim is to provide a one-stop solution for students to understand & apply math concepts in real-time & our approach is to make math engaging, & interactive by combining theory, application, and experiments. 

As we all know only the Physics, Chemistry, and Biological lab are, but EduMEasy has developed the Math Lab for students, in this, students will teach math with practical. EduMEasy Math Lab for School has a delightful workshop for every student who faces difficulty in Math and this ads surplus to the studies and also will have a remarkable impact on the learning experience of thousands of students. It helps to visualize a concept of mathematics by understanding the concepts and makes learning easy.

Visualization and experimentation are two important aspects of teaching mathematics. In their paper, Rosken and Rolka (2006) concluded that

– A picture is worth 1000 words if one is aware of its scope.
– A picture is worth 1000 words if one is able to use it flexibly.

Researchers observed that understanding patterns and visualization helps a student learn even complex mathematics and apply them to new problems. The team from IIT Jodhpur (professors & alumni) who conceived and developed this Math Lab are convinced that this lab provides a platform for teachers to teach the theoretical/abstract concepts of mathematics through experiments and visualizations. It is accompanied by study material for reflective thinking to regular reference by the experiments.

Almost 50% of students are afraid of maths. Math is the most scoring subject in competitive exams like JEE. But a better score can only be secured with the help of the best faculty which is practically impossible in most cases. Keeping these things in mind, EduMEasy has made the equipment for Maths Lab which will help students to learn math in a better and more joyful manner.

This equipment is going to make math easy and more results Oriented and students are going to love this equipment so they will be able to understand math easily. This equipment is very useful and colorful too. Concepts and colors both matter. This Math Lab foe schools designed & developed by IITians will bring revolution to the field of Math. Available Math Lab equipment from 6th to 10th class as per NCERT base.

So Contact EduMEasy to solve this problem with its Math Lab for Schools to establish Math Lab in Schools.

item.title: About-three
item.dc:creator: adminvivek
item.content:encoded:
What is math lab & Why is useful for students?

A mathematics laboratory is a place where anybody can experiment and explore patterns and ideas. It is a place where one can find a collection of games, puzzles, and other teaching and learning material.

The maths lab provides an opportunity for the students to discover mathematics through doing. Many of the activities present a problem or a challenge, with the possibility of generating further challenges and problems. The activities help students to visualize, manipulate, and reason. They provide an opportunity to make conjectures and test them, and generalize observed patterns. They create a context for students to attempt to prove their conjectures.

Mathematics laboratory is a place to enjoy mathematics through informal exploration. It is a place where anyone can generate problems and struggle to get an answer. It is a space to explore and design new mathematical activities. So, the maths lab should not be used to assess students’ knowledge of mathematics. Often mathematics lab takes students’ knowledge beyond the curriculum.

The Mathematics laboratory is a self-explanatory lab with activities, in which students could come anytime (free to them) and engage in the work, continue working on the problems/tasks, and use teachers as and when they are stuck. In this way, the role of the teacher is not to teach how to progress in the activity but to facilitate inquiry with the mathematics in it.

NEED AND PURPOSE:

Some of the ways in which a Mathematics Laboratory can contribute to the learning of the subject are:

  • It provides an opportunity for students to understand and internalize basic mathematical concepts through concrete objects and situations.
  • It enables the students to verify or discover several geometrical properties and facts using models or paper-cutting and folding techniques.
  • It helps the students to build interest and confidence in learning the subject.
    The laboratory provides an opportunity to exhibit the relatedness of mathematical concepts with everyday life.
  • It provides greater scope for individual participation in the process of learning and becoming autonomous learners.
  • The laboratory allows and encourages the students to think, and discuss with each other and the teacher, and assimilate the concepts in a more effective manner.
  • It enables the teacher to demonstrate, explain and reinforce abstract mathematical ideas by using concrete objects, models, charts, graphs, pictures, etc..
  • It provides an opportunity to understand and internalize basic mathematical concepts through concrete objects and situations.
  • It enables the students to verify or discover several geometrical properties and facts using models or paper-cutting and folding techniques.
  • It helps the students to build interest and confidence in learning the subject.
  • The laboratory provides an opportunity to exhibit the relatedness of mathematical concepts with everyday life.
  • It provides greater scope for individual participation in the process of learning and becoming autonomous learners.
  • It provides scope for greater involvement of both the mind and the hand which facilitates cognition.
  • The laboratory allows and encourages students to think, and discuss with each other and the teacher and assimilate the concepts in a more effective manner.
  • It enables the teacher to demonstrate, explain and reinforce abstract mathematical ideas by using concrete objects, models, charts, graphs, pictures, posters, etc.

Objectives of Mathematics Laboratory

  • To provide readily accessible rich manipulative materials to emphasis on “learning by doing”.
  • To develop an attitude of inquiry.
  • Remove the weakness of present-day mathematics education.

What is math lab & Why is useful for students?

A mathematics laboratory is a place where anybody can experiment and explore patterns and ideas. It is a place where one can find a collection of games, puzzles, and other teaching and learning material.

The maths lab provides an opportunity for the students to discover mathematics through doing. Many of the activities present a problem or a challenge, with the possibility of generating further challenges and problems. The activities help students to visualize, manipulate, and reason. They provide an opportunity to make conjectures and test them, and generalize observed patterns. They create a context for students to attempt to prove their conjectures.

Mathematics laboratory is a place to enjoy mathematics through informal exploration. It is a place where anyone can generate problems and struggle to get an answer. It is a space to explore and design new mathematical activities. So, the maths lab should not be used to assess students’ knowledge of mathematics. Often mathematics lab takes students’ knowledge beyond the curriculum.

The Mathematics laboratory is a self-explanatory lab with activities, in which students could come anytime (free to them) and engage in the work, continue working on the problems/tasks, and use teachers as and when they are stuck. In this way, the role of the teacher is not to teach how to progress in the activity but to facilitate inquiry with the mathematics in it.

NEED AND PURPOSE:

Some of the ways in which a Mathematics Laboratory can contribute to the learning of the subject are:

  • It provides an opportunity for students to understand and internalize basic mathematical concepts through concrete objects and situations.
  • It enables the students to verify or discover several geometrical properties and facts using models or paper-cutting and folding techniques.
  • It helps the students to build interest and confidence in learning the subject.
    The laboratory provides an opportunity to exhibit the relatedness of mathematical concepts with everyday life.
  • It provides greater scope for individual participation in the process of learning and becoming autonomous learners.
  • The laboratory allows and encourages the students to think, and discuss with each other and the teacher, and assimilate the concepts in a more effective manner.
  • It enables the teacher to demonstrate, explain and reinforce abstract mathematical ideas by using concrete objects, models, charts, graphs, pictures, etc..

  • It provides scope for greater involvement of both the mind and the hand which facilitates cognition.
  • The laboratory allows and encourages students to think, and discuss with each other and the teacher and assimilate the concepts in a more effective manner.
  • It enables the teacher to demonstrate, explain and reinforce abstract mathematical ideas by using concrete objects, models, charts, graphs, pictures, posters, etc.

Objectives of Mathematics Laboratory

  • To provide readily accessible rich manipulative materials to emphasis on “learning by doing”.
  • To develop an attitude of inquiry.
  • Remove the weakness of present-day mathematics education.
  • To develop much-needed confidence in students.
  • To generate interest in the subject.

  • To make the children look for patterns and ask questions.

item.dc:creator: adminvivek
item.content:encoded:
MA-01: ALGEBRA ANNOTATOR

The biggest challenge in learning Algebra is understanding the operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of the variables and functions of the variables. The Algebra annotator is designed for learning by visualizing and doing activities involving variables. This is one of the finest math lab equipment and model for Algebra.

Class – 6

Chapters, Algebra

Class – 7

Chapters, Simple Equation, Algebraic expressions, Exponents and Powers

Class – 8

Chapters, Linear equation in one variable, Algebraic Expressions, Exponents and Powers, Factorisation

Class – 9

MA-03: GEOMETRY EXPOSITOR

Bothered about understating the statements and proofs of theorems! No worries, this one piece of equipment is the solution bank of all Geometrical concepts. Starting from understating the angles between two lines to visualizing the properties of parallel lines and triangles, this single equipment is loaded with a number of activities to excite the students. This equipment is it even serves the purpose of learning trigonometry.    

Class – 6

Basic geometry idea, Understanding of elementary shapes, Symmetry, Practical geometry

Class – 7

Lines and angles, Congruence of triangles, Practical geometry, Symmetry

Class – 8

Quadrilaterals

Class – 9

Introduction to euclid’s geometry, Lines and angles, Triangles, Quadrilaterals

Class – 10

Triangles, Introduction to trigonometry

MA-04: CO-ORDINATE SYSTEM DEMONSTRATOR

The basis of Co-ordinate Geometry is the coordinate system. For understanding the different quadrants and coordinates in a two-dimensional plane, this system demonstrates several different properties to visualize Co-ordinate Geometry. It helps in understanding the solutions of equations, roots of polynomials etc. 

Class – 6

Chapters, Prime and composite number, Decimals, Ratio and Proportion

Class – 7

Chapters, Rational Numbers

Class – 8

Chapters, Rational numbers, Square and square roots, Cube and cube roots, Direct and Inverse proportion

Class – 9

Chapters, Number system, Co-ordinate geometry, Linear Equation in two variables

Class – 10

Chapters, Real numbers, Polynomials, Pair of equations, Quadratic equation, Arithmetic Progression, Co-ordinate geometry, Statistics

MA-05: CIRCLE DESCRIPTOR

It starts and ends at the same point. The circle is one of the most beautiful geometrical figures which has several good characteristics. However, understating the properties and theorems is a herculean task. The descriptor is designed for doing some experiments for learning the Circle in a linear manner. The descriptor is also useful in learning fractions & elementary probability. 

Class – 7

Chapters, Comparing quantities

Class – 8

Chapters, Comparing quantities

Class – 9

Chapters, Circles

Class – 10

Chapters, Circles, Area Related to Circle, Probability

ALGEBRA ANNOTATOR Math Lab Equipment

The biggest challenge in learning Algebra is understanding the operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of the variables and functions of the variables. The Algebra annotator is designed for learning by visualizing and doing activities involving variables. This is one of the finest math lab equipment and model for Algebra.

This algebra annotator math lab equipment covers the following chapters, class wise which is an aid in teaching and learning math & the given accessories that will be provided by EduMEasy.

Covering Algebra Chapters with Classes:

  • Class 6 – Algebra
  • Class 7 – Simple Equation, Algebraic expressions, Exponents and Powers
  • Class 8 – Linear equation in one variable, Algebraic Expressions, Exponents and Powers, Factorisation
  • Class 9 – Polynomial, Probability

Accessories that will be provided with Algebra Annotator:

  • Size: 3 ft x 3 ft in a square shape
  • Square plates Qty – 68 nos.
  • Rectangular Qty – 08 nos.
  • Balance (Traju) Qty -01 nos.
  • Allen key Qty – 01 nos.
  • Tripod Stand Qty – 01 nos.
  • Tray for holding Plates Qty – 01 nos.

Welcome To

EduMEasy

Welcome To
EduMEasy

World's first comprehensive Math Lab for Schools

EduMEasy is a start-up by a group of IITians inclined to solve the difficulty in understanding abstract mathematical concepts via visualization & experimentation. Our aim is to provide a one-stop solution for students to understand and apply mathematical concepts in real-time. Our approach is to make math interesting, visual, and interactive by combining theory, applications, and experiments. The impact of our work will be felt when there is no Math phobia among the students. The idea of EduMEasy is simple: by setting up real-life situations, we can let students explore mathematical concepts at their own pace & at their own place. In an age where kids are hooked on playing games, we believe that math should be fun for all. So EduMEasy is here to solve this problem with its Math Lab for Schools to establish Math Lab in Schools. With the help of this platform, students can unlock their knowledge about mathematical concepts, which otherwise may have remained locked or inaccessible at their fingertips due to a lack of proper understanding of them. 

EduMEasy also brings DIY (Do It Yourself) Math Kit for children to learn Math with fun & Joy.

Unlock the Joy of Learning: Introducing Math Lab Equipment for Primary Classes!Now expanding our Math Lab to primary classes! Engaging tools designed to make learning math fun and interactive for young minds.Book DemoMath Lab: Where Numbers DanceEnter our Math Lab, where the language of the universe is written in numbers. Witness the mesmerizing dance of mathematical concepts as they unfold before your eyes. Prepare to be enchanted by the elegance and grace of numerical harmony.Book DemoExploring Mathematical FrontiersWelcome to the frontier of mathematical exploration. Here, in our Math Lab, we embark on a journey of discovery, pushing the boundaries of what is known and venturing into the unknown. Join us as we chart new territories and unravel the mysteries of the mathematical universe.Book DemoUnraveling Mathematical MysteriesStep into our Math Lab, where mysteries await unraveling. Armed with curiosity and intellect, we delve into the enigmatic depths of mathematical puzzles. From the elegance of geometry to the complexity of calculus, join us on a quest to uncover the secrets hidden within the realm of numbers.Book Demo

Welcome To

EduMEasy

Welcome To
EduMEasy

World's first comprehensive Math Lab for Schools

EduMEasy is a start-up by a group of IITians inclined to solve the difficulty in understanding abstract mathematical concepts via visualization & experimentation. Our aim is to provide a one-stop solution for students to understand and apply mathematical concepts in real-time. Our approach is to make math interesting, visual, and interactive by combining theory, applications, and experiments. The impact of our work will be felt when there is no Math phobia among the students. The idea of EduMEasy is simple: by setting up real-life situations, we can let students explore mathematical concepts at their own pace & at their own place. In an age where kids are hooked on playing games, we believe that math should be fun for all. So EduMEasy is here to solve this problem with its Math Lab for Schools to establish Math Lab in Schools. With the help of this platform, students can unlock their knowledge about mathematical concepts, which otherwise may have remained locked or inaccessible at their fingertips due to a lack of proper understanding of them. 

EduMEasy also brings DIY (Do It Yourself) Math Kit for children to learn Math with fun & Joy.

Let’s EduMEasy Numbers Talk
Years in Business 0 + Number of Lab Install 0 Products 0 + Happy Clients 0 +

Maths Lab - Thought Provoking Experiments

By EduMEasy: Math Lab

Maths Lab - Concept In Real-Time Situation

By EduMEasy: Math Lab

Maths Lab - Abstract Mathematical Concept

By EduMEasy: Math Lab

Math Lab Equipments

Not just geometry or mensuration—now we've created math lab equipment for algebra, number systems, trigonometry, and every school-level math topic. 

Primary Lab

Multiplicator

An innovative tool that simplifies multiplication and introduces positive and negative numbers through hands-on, engaging learning experiences.

Read More

Shape Discriminator

A hands-on tool to explore geometric figures, fractions, and their operations, making geometry and fractions interactive and engaging.

Read More

Time and Angle Tracker

A versatile tool that simplifies time, angles, and their properties through hands-on exploration and visual learning aids.

Read More

Decimals Operator

An interactive toolkit to master decimal place values, solve problems, and perform measurements, making decimal concepts clear and practical.

Read More

Pattern Finder

A fun tool to explore patterns, solve matching problems, and boost critical thinking, making math exciting and creativity-driven for young learners.

Read More

Mensurator

A versatile tool for exploring perimeter, area, inequalities, division, multiplication, factors, HCF, and LCM, enhancing problem-solving skills in geometry and arithmetic.

Read More

Number Interactor

An interactive tool for mastering addition, subtraction, and inequalities, making foundational arithmetic fun and hands-on.

 

Read More

Number Twister

An interactive tool to explore even, odd, prime numbers, and divisors, making fundamental number concepts engaging and easy to understand.

Read More

Advanced Math Lab

ALGEBRA ANNOTATOR

The biggest challenge in learning algebra is understanding the operations such as addition & subtraction.

Read More

NUMBER SYSTEM

A positive or a negative outcome is always a problem in using operations between numbers is Number Operator.

Read More

FRACTIONS TESTER

How is whole divided into fractions? How different fractions are combined to get whole?

Read More

EQUATION SOLVER

Are two linear equations always solvable? If they are, is the solution unique? this will solve by Equation Solver.

Read More

GEOMETRY EXPOSITOR

Bothered about understating the statements and proofs of theorems! No worries.

item.content:encoded:
Maths Lab Equipments Suppliers in India

As we all know that everyone knows about only physics, chemistry, and biological lab, but EduMEasy has developed the Math Lab for students, In this, students will teach math with practical. EduMEasy Math Lab for School has a delightful workshop or activity for every student who faces difficulty in Math and this adds surplus to the studies and also will have a remarkable impact on the learning experience of thousands of students.

It helps to visualize a concept of mathematics by understanding the concepts and makes learning easy. Almost 50% of students are afraid of maths. Math is the most scoring subject in competitive exams. But a better score can only be secured with the help of the best faculty which is practically impossible in most cases. Keeping these things in mind, EduMEasy has made the equipment for Maths Lab which will help students to learn math in a better and more joyful manner.

This equipment is going to make math easy and more results Oriented and students are going to love this equipment so they will be able to understand math easily. This equipment is very useful and colorful too. Concepts and colors both matter. This Math Lab developed by IITians will bring revolution to the field of Math. Available Math Lab equipment from 6th to 10th class. So contact the team for more information to Book a Demo of the Math Lab.

Unlock the Joy of Learning: Introducing Math Lab Equipment for Primary Classes!Now expanding our Math Lab to primary classes! Engaging tools designed to make learning math fun and interactive for young minds.Book DemoA Complete Math Lab Solution for Every Class!From basics to advanced topics, our Math Labs ensure an engaging and comprehensive learning experience for all grades.Book DemoMath Lab: Where Numbers DanceEnter our Math Lab, where the language of the universe is written in numbers. Witness the mesmerizing dance of mathematical concepts as they unfold before your eyes. Prepare to be enchanted by the elegance and grace of numerical harmony.Book DemoExploring Mathematical FrontiersWelcome to the frontier of mathematical exploration. Here, in our Math Lab, we embark on a journey of discovery, pushing the boundaries of what is known and venturing into the unknown. Join us as we chart new territories and unravel the mysteries of the mathematical universe.Book DemoUnraveling Mathematical MysteriesStep into our Math Lab, where mysteries await unraveling. Armed with curiosity and intellect, we delve into the enigmatic depths of mathematical puzzles. From the elegance of geometry to the complexity of calculus, join us on a quest to uncover the secrets hidden within the realm of numbers.Book Demo

Welcome To

EduMEasy

Welcome To
EduMEasy

World's first comprehensive Math Lab for Schools

EduMEasy is a start-up by a group of IITians inclined to solve the difficulty in understanding abstract mathematical concepts via visualization & experimentation. Our aim is to provide a one-stop solution for students to understand and apply mathematical concepts in real-time. Our approach is to make math interesting, visual, and interactive by combining theory, applications, and experiments. The impact of our work will be felt when there is no Math phobia among the students. The idea of EduMEasy is simple: by setting up real-life situations, we can let students explore mathematical concepts at their own pace & at their own place. In an age where kids are hooked on playing games, we believe that math should be fun for all. So EduMEasy is here to solve this problem with its Math Lab for Schools to establish Math Lab in Schools. With the help of this platform, students can unlock their knowledge about mathematical concepts, which otherwise may have remained locked or inaccessible at their fingertips due to a lack of proper understanding of them. 

EduMEasy also brings DIY (Do It Yourself) Math Kit for children to learn Math with fun & Joy.

Let’s EduMEasy Numbers Talk
Years in Business 0 + Number of Lab Install 0 Products 0 + Happy Clients 0 +

Maths Lab - Thought Provoking Experiments

By EduMEasy: Math Lab

Maths Lab - Concept In Real-Time Situation

By EduMEasy: Math Lab

Maths Lab - Abstract Mathematical Concept

By EduMEasy: Math Lab

Math Lab Manuals & Equipments

Not just geometry or mensuration—now we've created math lab equipment for algebra, number systems, trigonometry, and every school-level math topic. 

Primary Lab

Complete Guide for Teachers about Math Lab for School, Chapter wise as per syllabus

Multiplicator

An innovative tool that simplifies multiplication and introduces positive and negative numbers through hands-on, engaging learning experiences.

Read More

Shape Discriminator

A hands-on tool to explore geometric figures, fractions, and their operations, making geometry and fractions interactive and engaging.

Read More

Time and Angle Tracker

A versatile tool that simplifies time, angles, and their properties through hands-on exploration and visual learning aids.

Read More

Decimals Operator

An interactive toolkit to master decimal place values, solve problems, and perform measurements, making decimal concepts clear and practical.

Read More

Pattern Finder

A fun tool to explore patterns, solve matching problems, and boost critical thinking, making math exciting and creativity-driven for young learners.

Read More

Mensurator

A versatile tool for exploring perimeter, area, inequalities, division, multiplication, factors, HCF, and LCM, enhancing problem-solving skills in geometry and arithmetic.

Read More

Number Interactor

An interactive tool for mastering addition, subtraction, and inequalities, making foundational arithmetic fun and hands-on.

Read More

Number Twister

An interactive tool to explore even, odd, prime numbers, and divisors, making fundamental number concepts engaging and easy to understand.

Read More

Advanced Math Lab

Complete Guide for Teachers about Math Lab for School, Chapter wise as per syllabus

ALGEBRA ANNOTATOR

The biggest challenge in learning algebra is understanding the operations such as addition & subtraction.

Read More

NUMBER SYSTEM

A positive or a negative outcome is always a problem in using operations between numbers is Number Operator.

Read More

FRACTIONS TESTER

How is whole divided into fractions? How different fractions are combined to get whole?

Read More

EQUATION SOLVER

Are two linear equations always solvable? If they are, is the solution unique? this will solve by Equation Solver.

Read More

GEOMETRY EXPOSITOR

Bothered about understating the statements and proofs of theorems! No worries.

Read More

CO-ORDINATE SYSTEM

The basis of coordinate geometry is the coordinate system.  basis of coordinate geometry is the coordinate system.

Read More

CIRCLE DESCRIPTOR

It starts and ends at the same point. The circle is one of the most beautiful geometrical figure.

Read More

MENSURATION EVL.

Measurement of area and volume of solids is one of the most interesting exercises.

Read More

Never stop learning, because life never stops teaching

By EduMEasy Math Learning Program with Lab design

Client Testimonials​

Teaching and learning Math is made practically easy, teachers are empowered and children are getting rid of their Math phobia. The real 'learning-by-doing' approach is helping students understand the complexities and abstractness of Mathematics. Moreover the concern and support of the team 'EduMeasy' is worth appreciating. Manisha Lashkari​ Principal, Smart Study International School - Rajsamand I have only gone through physics, chemistry and biological lab, mathematics had no lab only books when we saw this lab had practical implications. Almost 50% of students are afraid of maths. Math is the most scoring subject in competitive exam like JEE. But better score can only be secured with the help of best faculty which is practically not possible in most of the cases. These 7 equipment will act as a faculty for math to help students score better and understand deep concepts in easy manner.​ Tilkesh Bhatiya​ Director, SSIS International School - Nathdwara Here is what he feels about the Math Lab - I am thrilled to see this type of equipment which is expected from IITians only and will help students to learn math in a better and Joyful manner. Nitin Bhargav HOD, Tagore international School We strongly feel these equipment will bring revolution in the field of Mathematics from 6th -10 th class. It helps to visualise a concept of mathematics by understanding the concepts and also makes learning a very very fun field. Aurobindo Centre of New Education Here is what she expressed about the Math Lab - These equipments are going to make my Job easy and more result Oriented and students are going to love these equipment so they will be able to understand math easily. Last but not the least the equipment is very useful and colourful too . Concepts and colours both matter. Jagriti Arora Faculty of Mathematics, Kudos International School - Bundi As a struggling math student, I was hesitant to seek help, but the math lab is a game-changer for me. The lab offers a variety of resources, including lab equipment, Manuals (in Hindi & English), and support, which have helped me grasp difficult concepts and improve my problem-solving skills. Welcome To

EduMEasy

Welcome To
EduMEasy

World's first comprehensive Math Lab for Schools

EduMEasy is a start-up by a group of IITians inclined to solve the difficulty in understanding abstract mathematical concepts via visualization & experimentation. Our aim is to provide a one-stop solution for students to understand and apply mathematical concepts in real-time. Our approach is to make math interesting, visual, and interactive by combining theory, applications, and experiments. The impact of our work will be felt when there is no Math phobia among the students. The idea of EduMEasy is simple: by setting up real-life situations, we can let students explore mathematical concepts at their own pace & at their own place. In an age where kids are hooked on playing games, we believe that math should be fun for all. So EduMEasy is here to solve this problem with its Math Lab for Schools to establish Math Lab in Schools. With the help of this platform, students can unlock their knowledge about mathematical concepts, which otherwise may have remained locked or inaccessible at their fingertips due to a lack of proper understanding of them. 

EduMEasy also brings DIY (Do It Yourself) Math Kit for children to learn Math with fun & Joy.

Let’s EduMEasy Numbers Talk
Years in Business 0 + Number of Lab Install 0 Products 0 + Happy Clients 0 +

Unlock the Joy of Learning: Introducing Math Lab Equipment for Primary Classes!Now expanding our Math Lab to primary classes! Engaging tools designed to make learning math fun and interactive for young minds.Book DemoA Complete Math Lab Solution for Every Class!From basics to advanced topics, our Math Labs ensure an engaging and comprehensive learning experience for all grades.Book DemoMath Lab: Where Numbers DanceEnter our Math Lab, where the language of the universe is written in numbers. Witness the mesmerizing dance of mathematical concepts as they unfold before your eyes. Prepare to be enchanted by the elegance and grace of numerical harmony.Book DemoExploring Mathematical FrontiersWelcome to the frontier of mathematical exploration. Here, in our Math Lab, we embark on a journey of discovery, pushing the boundaries of what is known and venturing into the unknown. Join us as we chart new territories and unravel the mysteries of the mathematical universe.Book DemoUnraveling Mathematical MysteriesStep into our Math Lab, where mysteries await unraveling. Armed with curiosity and intellect, we delve into the enigmatic depths of mathematical puzzles. From the elegance of geometry to the complexity of calculus, join us on a quest to uncover the secrets hidden within the realm of numbers.Book Demo

ALGEBRA ANNOTATOR

The biggest challenge in learning algebra is understanding the operations such as addition & subtraction.

NUMBER SYSTEM

FRACTIONS TESTER

How is whole divided into fractions? How different fractions are combined to get whole?

Unlock the Joy of Learning: Introducing Math Lab Equipment for Primary Classes!Now expanding our Math Lab to primary classes! Engaging tools designed to make learning math fun and interactive for young minds.Book DemoA Complete Math Lab Solution for Every Class!From basics to advanced topics, our Math Labs ensure an engaging and comprehensive learning experience for all grades.Book DemoMath Lab: Where Numbers DanceEnter our Math Lab, where the language of the universe is written in numbers. Witness the mesmerizing dance of mathematical concepts as they unfold before your eyes. Prepare to be enchanted by the elegance and grace of numerical harmony.Book DemoExploring Mathematical FrontiersWelcome to the frontier of mathematical exploration. Here, in our Math Lab, we embark on a journey of discovery, pushing the boundaries of what is known and venturing into the unknown. Join us as we chart new territories and unravel the mysteries of the mathematical universe.Book DemoUnraveling Mathematical MysteriesStep into our Math Lab, where mysteries await unraveling. Armed with curiosity and intellect, we delve into the enigmatic depths of mathematical puzzles. From the elegance of geometry to the complexity of calculus, join us on a quest to uncover the secrets hidden within the realm of numbers.Book Demo

Explore Our Math Labs​

Explore how our Math Labs transform learning with hands-on tools, engaging both foundational and advanced learners intuitively and effectively.

Primary

Discover how our PrimaryMath Labs make learning intuitive with hands-on tools for all levels.

explore

Advanced

The Advanced Math Lab helps students master topics like trigonometry, algebra, and geometry.

Explore
Let’s EduMEasy Numbers Talk
Years in Business 0 + Number of Lab Install 0 Products 0 + Happy Clients 0 +

Thought Provoking Experiments

Concept In Real-Time Situation

Abstract Mathematical Concept

Math Lab Equipments

Not just geometry or mensuration—now we've created math lab equipment for algebra, number systems, trigonometry, and every school-level math topic. 

ALGEBRA ANNOTATOR

The biggest challenge in learning algebra is understanding the operations such as addition & subtraction.

Read More

NUMBER SYSTEM

A positive or a negative outcome is always a problem in using operations between numbers is Number Operator.

Read More

FRACTIONS TESTER

How is whole divided into fractions? How different fractions are combined to get whole?

Read More

EQUATION SOLVER

Are two linear equations always solvable? If they are, is the solution unique? this will solve by Equation Solver.

Read More

GEOMETRY EXPOSITOR

Bothered about understating the statements and proofs of theorems! No worries.

Read More

CO-ORDINATE SYSTEM

The basis of coordinate geometry is the coordinate system.  basis of coordinate geometry is the coordinate system.

Read More

CIRCLE DESCRIPTOR

It starts and ends at the same point. The circle is one of the most beautiful geometrical figure.

Read More

MENSURATION EVL.

Measurement of area and volume of solids is one of the most interesting exercises.

Read More

Lab Manuals

Complete Guide for Teachers about Math Lab for School, Chapter wise as per syllabus

Never stop learning, because life never stops teaching

By EduMEasy Math Learning Program with Lab design

Client Testimonials​

Teaching and learning Math is made practically easy, teachers are empowered and children are getting rid of their Math phobia. The real 'learning-by-doing' approach is helping students understand the complexities and abstractness of Mathematics. Moreover the concern and support of the team 'EduMeasy' is worth appreciating. Manisha Lashkari​ Principal, Smart Study International School - Rajsamand I have only gone through physics, chemistry and biological lab, mathematics had no lab only books when we saw this lab had practical implications. Almost 50% of students are afraid of maths. Math is the most scoring subject in competitive exam like JEE. But better score can only be secured with the help of best faculty which is practically not possible in most of the cases. These 7 equipment will act as a faculty for math to help students score better and understand deep concepts in easy manner.​ Tilkesh Bhatiya​ Director, SSIS International School - Nathdwara Here is what he feels about the Math Lab - I am thrilled to see this type of equipment which is expected from IITians only and will help students to learn math in a better and Joyful manner. Nitin Bhargav HOD, Tagore international School We strongly feel these equipment will bring revolution in the field of Mathematics from 6th -10 th class. It helps to visualise a concept of mathematics by understanding the concepts and also makes learning a very very fun field. Aurobindo Centre of New Education Here is what she expressed about the Math Lab - These equipments are going to make my Job easy and more result Oriented and students are going to love these equipment so they will be able to understand math easily. Last but not the least the equipment is very useful and colourful too . Concepts and colours both matter. Jagriti Arora Faculty of Mathematics, Kudos International School - Bundi As a struggling math student, I was hesitant to seek help, but the math lab is a game-changer for me. The lab offers a variety of resources, including lab equipment, Manuals (in Hindi & English), and support, which have helped me grasp difficult concepts and improve my problem-solving skills. Dr. Chinmay Pandya Ji Pro VC of Devsanskriti Vishvavidyalaya https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PAiKj45sSc8&t=1s

Dr. Pradeep Kumawat Ji about EduMEasy: Mathematics Laboratory for Schools to provide a one-stop solution for students to understand and apply math concepts practically.

https://youtu.be/oMjuo24OMqM

Mr. Tilkesh Bhatiya about EduMEasy: Mathematics Laboratory for Schools to provide a one-stop solution for students to understand and apply math concepts practically.

https://youtu.be/GpKpfKzfqeg

Nitin Bhargav Ji about EduMEasy: Mathematics Laboratory for Schools to provide a one-stop solution for students to understand and apply math concepts practically.

Edumeasy Clients

Maths Lab Equipments Suppliers in India

As we all know that everyone knows about only physics, chemistry, and biological lab, but EduMEasy has developed the Math Lab for students, In this, students will teach math with practical. EduMEasy Math Lab for School has a delightful workshop or activity for every student who faces difficulty in Math and this adds surplus to the studies and also will have a remarkable impact on the learning experience of thousands of students.

It helps to visualize a concept of mathematics by understanding the concepts and makes learning easy. Almost 50% of students are afraid of maths. Math is the most scoring subject in competitive exams. But a better score can only be secured with the help of the best faculty which is practically impossible in most cases. Keeping these things in mind, EduMEasy has made the equipment for Maths Lab which will help students to learn math in a better and more joyful manner.

This equipment is going to make math easy and more results Oriented and students are going to love this equipment so they will be able to understand math easily. This equipment is very useful and colorful too. Concepts and colors both matter. This Math Lab developed by IITians will bring revolution to the field of Math. Available Math Lab equipment from 6th to 10th class. So contact the team for more information to Book a Demo of the Math Lab.

item.content:encoded:
Dr. Vivek Vijay

Associate Professor


Department of Mathematics
IIT Jodhpur




Mentor & Director

Vivek Vijay is a passionate educator and Associate Professor of Mathematics at IIT Jodhpur. As the Director and Mentor of Edumeasy, he combines his academic expertise and leadership to make education engaging and accessible for students worldwide. His vision drives the creation of innovative tools and resources, transforming how students learn and interact with mathematics.

Facebook-f Twitter Dribbble Behance

Dr. Sandeep Yadav

Associate Professor


Department of Electrical Engineering
IIT Jodhpur




Mentor & Director

Sandeep Kumar Yadav is an Associate Professor at the Indian Institute of Technology, Jodhpur, with a distinguished academic and research background. His expertise spans Signal Processing (Acoustic and Vibration), Condition Monitoring, Artificial Neural Networks, Blind Source Separation, Image Processing, and Machine Learning. As a Mentor and Director at Edumeasy, he leverages his rich experience and innovative approach to develop transformative educational tools that empower students to excel in mathematics and beyond.

item.title: Team member one
item.dc:creator: adminvivek
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Vivek Vijay

Associate Professor


Department of Mathematics
IIT Jodhpur




Mentor & Director

Vivek Vijay is a passionate educator and Associate Professor of Mathematics at IIT Jodhpur. As the Director and Mentor of Edumeasy, he combines his academic expertise and leadership to make education engaging and accessible for students worldwide. His vision drives the creation of innovative tools and resources, transforming how students learn and interact with mathematics.

Facebook-f Twitter Dribbble Behance

Dr. Sandeep Yadav

Associate Professor


Department of Electrical Engineering
IIT Jodhpur




Mentor & Director

Sandeep Kumar Yadav is an Associate Professor at the Indian Institute of Technology, Jodhpur, with a distinguished academic and research background. His expertise spans Signal Processing (Acoustic and Vibration), Condition Monitoring, Artificial Neural Networks, Blind Source Separation, Image Processing, and Machine Learning. As a Mentor and Director at Edumeasy, he leverages his rich experience and innovative approach to develop transformative educational tools that empower students to excel in mathematics and beyond.

item.content:encoded:
Vivek Sahu

CEO & Founder

Vivek Kumar Sahu is the visionary CEO and Founder of Edumeasy, dedicated to revolutionizing the way students learn mathematics. A postgraduate in Mathematics from IIT Jodhpur, he combines his academic excellence with a passion for innovation to create engaging, hands-on learning tools. His leadership drives Edumeasy's mission to make mathematics accessible, interactive, and enjoyable for learners of all ages.

Facebook-f Twitter Dribbble Behance

Sunil Kumar

Chief Operating Officer

Sunil Kumar is the Chief Operating Officer of Edumeasy, responsible for overseeing daily operations and optimizing business processes. With extensive experience in operations management, he drives efficiency and ensures smooth execution of strategies. Sunil’s leadership contributes to the company’s growth and operational success.

item.title: old_About_needs_and Achvmnt
item.dc:creator: adminvivek
item.content:encoded:
What is Math Lab and why is useful for students?

A mathematics laboratory is a place where anybody can experiment and explore patterns and ideas. It is a place where one can find a collection of games, puzzles, and other teaching and learning material. The math lab provides an opportunity for the students to discover learning by doing method. Many of the activities present a problem or a challenge, with the possibility of generating further challenges and problems.

The activities help students to visualize, manipulate, and reason. They provide an opportunity to make conjectures and test them, and generalize observed patterns. They create a context for students to attempt to prove their conjectures. The Math Lab is a place to enjoy mathematics through informal exploration. It is a place where anyone can generate problems and struggle to get an answer. It is a space to explore and design new mathematical activities.

Often Math lab takes students’ knowledge beyond the curriculum. The Math Lab is a self-explanatory lab with activities, in which students could come anytime (free to them) and engage in the work, continue working on the problems/tasks, and use teachers as and when they are stuck. In this way, the role of the teacher is not to teach how to progress in the activity but to facilitate inquiry with the mathematics in it.

Need & Purpose of Math Lab for School

Some of the ways in which a Mathematics Laboratory can contribute to the learning of the subject are:

  • It provides an opportunity for students to understand and internalize basic mathematical concepts through concrete objects and situations.
  • It enables the students to verify or discover several geometrical properties and facts using the expositor.
  • It helps the students to build interest and confidence in learning the subject.
  • The laboratory provides an opportunity to exhibit the relatedness of mathematical concepts with everyday life.
  • It provides greater scope for individual participation in the process of learning and becoming autonomous learners.
  • The laboratory allows and encourages the students to think, and discuss with each other and the teacher, and assimilate the concepts in a more effective manner.
  • It enables the teacher to demonstrate, explain and reinforce abstract mathematical ideas by using concrete objects, models, charts, graphs, pictures, etc..

Objectives of Mathematics Laboratory:

  • To provide readily accessible rich manipulative materials to emphasize on “learning by doing”.
  • To develop an attitude of inquiry.
  • Remove the weakness of present-day mathematics education.
  • To develop much-needed confidence in students.
  • To generate interest in the subject.
  • To make the students divergent thinkers.
  • To make the children look for patterns and ask questions.

Our Achievements:

  • Collaborated on CSR-driven education projects with organizations such as Eklava Foundation, Indeed Foundation, and Saura Urja to expand access to quality mathematics education in schools.
  • Secured grant support from Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad in recognition of innovation and impact in experiential mathematics learning.
  • Received funding support from iHub Drishti Foundation, IIT Jodhpur to scale curriculum-aligned Math Lab solutions.
  • Awarded grant support by the Government of Rajasthan for contributing towards strengthening foundational learning and implementation of NEP 2020.
  • Successfully executed a large-scale government project in collaboration with the Government of Rajasthan, establishing mathematics labs in 120 government schools across Rajsamand.
  • Signed an MoU with the Rajasthan School Education Department for pilot implementation of Math Labs in government schools, reflecting strong institutional trust and validation.
  • Received Funding of ₹50 Lakhs from iHub Drishti Foundation, IIT Jodhpur, to scale our hands-on, curriculum-aligned Math Lab and expand nationwide.
  • Secured a Grant of ₹15 Lakhs from Kotak BizLabs under the prestigious IIMA Ventures program, recognizing our innovative approach in education technology.
  • EduMEasy was selected among the top 75 technologies for social impact in India by IIT Delhi (U.B.A.).
  • MoU cum agreement between RScSE (Department of School Education) and EduMEasy Pvt Ltd was signed on 23rd August 2022 for a pilot project in 11 schools of Jodhpur.
  • Collaborated on CSR projects with Surya Urja and JSW, installing Math Labs in Phalodi, Nagaur, and Nagpur's tribal area schools in partnership with the Maharashtra government.
  • Registered with i-Start and incubated by IIT Jodhpur.
  • Published an article titled “Math Lab: Learning Math by Doing Math” in the research journal IIT Jodhpur TechScape.
  • EduMEasy has presented the equipment to Honourable Shri Ashok Gehlot C.M. of Rajasthan.
  • EduMEasy has presented the equipment to Honourable Dr. B. D. Kalla, Education Minister, Rajasthan.
  • EduMEasy Pvt. Ltd. signed an MOU of Math Lab with the RCScE/Dept. of School Education, Government of Rajasthan.
  • EduMEasy Pvt. Ltd. Maths Lab is selected for the best snippets of IIT Jodhpur.
  • EduMEasy incubated in Istart Jodhpur.
  • EduMEasy has been selected out of the 75 best technologies in the Tech4Seva Event Activity of Unnati Mahotsav & Expo organized by Unnat Bharat Abhiyan at IIT Delhi.
  • EduMEasy Pvt. Ltd. got 2nd rank in Tech4Seva under AATMA NIRBHAR BHARAT (Unnat Bharat Abhiyan) at IIT Jodhpur
  • EduMEasy Participated in the IIS University 8th Rajasthan Science Congress Summit in October 2021.
  • EduMEasy Participated in the Padharo IIT in 2022 as well as 2023, IIT Jodhpur .
  • EduMEasy presented Math Lab in Chenpura School with Indeed NGO.
  • EduMEasy presented Maths Lab in RSS (Adarsh Vidhya Mandir) Group.
  • EduMEasy presented Maths Lab and installed in Shantikunj Haridwar inaugurated by DR. Chinmay Pandya
  • EduMEasy presented Maths Lab in Kendriya group and also installed maths lab and kits to K.V. IIT Jodhpur
  • EduMEasy visited DIDAC India.

We look forward to working with the esteemed institution and supporting efforts in maximizing the field of education. We are confident that we can meet the challenges ahead, and stand ready to partner in delivering an effective and world-changing innovation. If any further questions or require assistance, please feel free to ask. We're here to support school Math Lab education needs.

What is Math Lab and why is useful for students?<\/h4>

A mathematics laboratory is a place where anybody can experiment and explore patterns and ideas. It is a place where one can find a collection of games, puzzles, and other teaching and learning material. The math lab provides an opportunity for the students to discover learning by doing method. Many of the activities present a problem or a challenge, with the possibility of generating further challenges and problems.<\/p>

The activities help students to visualize, manipulate, and reason. They provide an opportunity to make conjectures and test them, and generalize observed patterns. They create a context for students to attempt to prove their conjectures. The Math Lab is a place to enjoy mathematics through informal exploration. It is a place where anyone can generate problems and struggle to get an answer. It is a space to explore and design new mathematical activities.<\/p>

Often Math lab takes students\u2019 knowledge beyond the curriculum. The Math Lab is a self-explanatory lab with activities<\/a>, in which students could come anytime (free to them) and engage in the work, continue working on the problems\/tasks, and use teachers as and when they are stuck. In this way, the role of the teacher is not to teach how to progress in the activity but to facilitate inquiry with the mathematics in it.<\/p>

Need & Purpose of Math Lab for School<\/h4>

Some of the ways in which a Mathematics Laboratory can contribute to the learning of the subject are:<\/p>

  • It provides an opportunity for students to understand and internalize basic mathematical concepts through concrete objects and situations.<\/li>
  • It enables the students to verify or discover several geometrical properties and facts using the expositor.<\/li>
  • It helps the students to build interest and confidence in learning the subject.<\/li>
  • The laboratory provides an opportunity to exhibit the relatedness of mathematical concepts with everyday life.<\/li>
  • It provides greater scope for individual participation in the process of learning and becoming autonomous learners.<\/li>
  • The laboratory allows and encourages the students to think, and discuss with each other and the teacher, and assimilate the concepts in a more effective manner.<\/li>
  • It enables the teacher to demonstrate, explain and reinforce abstract mathematical ideas by using concrete objects, models, charts, graphs, pictures, etc..<\/li><\/ul>

    Objectives of Mathematics Laboratory:<\/h4>
    • To provide readily accessible rich manipulative materials to emphasize on \u201clearning by doing\u201d.<\/li>
    • To develop an attitude of inquiry.<\/li>
    • Remove the weakness of present-day mathematics education.<\/li>
    • To develop much-needed confidence in students.<\/li>
    • To generate interest in the subject.<\/li>
    • To make the students divergent thinkers.<\/li>
    • To make the children look for patterns and ask questions.<\/li><\/ul>

      Our Achievements:<\/strong><\/h4>
      • Collaborated on CSR-driven education projects with organizations such as Eklava Foundation, Indeed Foundation, and Saura Urja to expand access to quality mathematics education in schools.<\/li>
      • Secured grant support from Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad<\/a> in recognition of innovation and impact in experiential mathematics learning.<\/li>
      • Received funding support from iHub Drishti Foundation, IIT Jodhpur<\/a> to scale curriculum-aligned Math Lab solutions.<\/li>
      • Awarded grant support by the Government of Rajasthan<\/span><\/span> for contributing towards strengthening foundational learning and implementation of NEP 2020.<\/li>
      • Successfully executed a large-scale government project in collaboration with the Government of Rajasthan<\/span><\/span>, establishing mathematics labs in 120 government schools across Rajsamand<\/span><\/span>.<\/li>
      • Signed an MoU with the Rajasthan School Education Department<\/span><\/span> for pilot implementation of Math Labs in government schools, reflecting strong institutional trust and validation.<\/li>
      • Received Funding of \u20b950 Lakhs from iHub Drishti Foundation, IIT Jodhpur, to scale our hands-on, curriculum-aligned Math Lab and expand nationwide.<\/li>
      • Secured a Grant of \u20b915 Lakhs from Kotak BizLabs under the prestigious IIMA Ventures program, recognizing our innovative approach in education technology.<\/li>
      • EduMEasy was selected among the top 75 technologies for social impact in India by IIT Delhi (U.B.A.).<\/li>
      • MoU cum agreement between RScSE (Department of School Education) and EduMEasy Pvt Ltd was signed on 23rd August 2022 for a pilot project in 11 schools of Jodhpur.<\/li>
      • Collaborated on CSR projects with Surya Urja and JSW, installing Math Labs in Phalodi, Nagaur, and Nagpur's tribal area schools in partnership with the Maharashtra government.<\/li>
      • Registered with i-Start and incubated by IIT Jodhpur.<\/li>
      • Published an article titled \u201cMath Lab: Learning Math by Doing Math\u201d in the research journal IIT Jodhpur\u00a0TechScape.<\/li>
      • EduMEasy has presented the equipment to Honourable Shri Ashok Gehlot C.M. of Rajasthan.<\/li>
      • EduMEasy has presented the equipment to Honourable Dr. B. D. Kalla, Education Minister, Rajasthan.<\/li>
      • EduMEasy Pvt. Ltd. signed an MOU of Math Lab with the RCScE\/Dept. of School Education, Government of Rajasthan.<\/li>
      • EduMEasy Pvt. Ltd. Maths Lab is selected for the best snippets of IIT Jodhpur.<\/li>
      • EduMEasy incubated in Istart Jodhpur.<\/li>
      • EduMEasy has been selected out of the 75 best technologies in the Tech4Seva Event Activity of Unnati Mahotsav & Expo organized by Unnat Bharat Abhiyan at IIT Delhi.<\/li>
      • EduMEasy Pvt. Ltd. got 2nd rank in Tech4Seva under AATMA NIRBHAR BHARAT (Unnat Bharat Abhiyan) at IIT Jodhpur<\/li>
      • EduMEasy Participated in the IIS University 8th Rajasthan Science Congress Summit in October 2021.<\/li>
      • EduMEasy Participated in the Padharo IIT in 2022 as well as 2023, IIT Jodhpur .<\/li>
      • EduMEasy presented Math Lab in Chenpura School with Indeed NGO.<\/li>
      • EduMEasy presented Maths Lab in RSS (Adarsh Vidhya Mandir) Group.<\/li>
      • EduMEasy presented Maths Lab and installed in Shantikunj Haridwar inaugurated by DR. Chinmay Pandya<\/li>
      • EduMEasy presented Maths Lab in Kendriya group and also installed maths lab and kits to K.V. IIT Jodhpur<\/li>
      • EduMEasy visited DIDAC India.<\/li><\/ul>

        We look forward to working with the esteemed institution and supporting efforts in maximizing the field of education. We are confident that we can meet the challenges ahead, and stand ready to partner in delivering an effective and world-changing innovation. If any further questions or require assistance, please feel free to ask. We're here to support school Math Lab education needs.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","align":"justify","typography_line_height":{"unit":"px","size":25,"sizes":[]},"text_color":"#020101"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Math Lab Schools - EduMEasy</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Poppins:wght@500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
 :root {
 --primary: #1a3c6e;
 --accent: #f7941d;
 --light-bg: #f0f4fb;
 --card-bg: #ffffff;
 --text-main: #1a2940;
 --text-sub: #4a6080;
 --border: #dde6f5;
 --tag-bg: #e8f0fd;
 --tag-text: #1a3c6e;
 --success: #1e9e6b;
 }

 * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

 body {
 font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif;
 background: var(--light-bg);
 color: var(--text-main);
 padding: 30px 16px 50px;
 }

 .section-header {
 text-align: center;
 margin-bottom: 28px;
 }

 .section-header .badge {
 display: inline-block;
 background: var(--accent);
 color: #fff;
 font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
 font-size: 11px;
 font-weight: 700;
 letter-spacing: 2px;
 text-transform: uppercase;
 padding: 5px 16px;
 border-radius: 20px;
 margin-bottom: 12px;
 }

 .section-header h2 {
 font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
 font-size: 26px;
 font-weight: 700;
 color: var(--primary);
 line-height: 1.3;
 }

 .section-header h2 span { color: var(--accent); }

 .section-header p {
 margin-top: 10px;
 color: var(--text-sub);
 font-size: 14px;
 }

 .count-bar {
 text-align: center;
 margin: 0 auto 32px;
 padding: 16px 24px;
 background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), #2a5aaa);
 border-radius: 14px;
 max-width: 380px;
 color: #fff;
 }

 .count-bar .count-num {
 font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
 font-size: 36px;
 font-weight: 800;
 line-height: 1;
 color: var(--accent);
 }

 .count-bar .count-label {
 font-size: 13px;
 opacity: 0.85;
 margin-top: 4px;
 }

 /* State section headings */
 .state-section {
 max-width: 1100px;
 margin: 0 auto 10px;
 padding: 0 16px;
 }

 .state-heading {
 display: flex;
 align-items: center;
 gap: 10px;
 margin-bottom: 14px;
 margin-top: 28px;
 }

 .state-heading .state-label {
 font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
 font-size: 13px;
 font-weight: 700;
 color: var(--primary);
 background: var(--tag-bg);
 padding: 4px 14px;
 border-radius: 20px;
 border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
 white-space: nowrap;
 }

 .state-heading .line {
 flex: 1;
 height: 1.5px;
 background: var(--border);
 border-radius: 2px;
 }

 /* Grid */
 .schools-grid {
 display: grid;
 grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(255px, 1fr));
 gap: 16px;
 max-width: 1100px;
 margin: 0 auto;
 padding: 0 16px;
 }

 /* Card */
 .school-card {
 background: var(--card-bg);
 border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
 border-radius: 14px;
 padding: 20px 18px 16px;
 display: flex;
 flex-direction: column;
 gap: 9px;
 box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(26,60,110,0.06);
 transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
 position: relative;
 overflow: hidden;
 }

 .school-card::before {
 content: '';
 position: absolute;
 top: 0; left: 0;
 width: 4px;
 height: 100%;
 background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent), var(--primary));
 border-radius: 14px 0 0 14px;
 }

 .school-card:hover {
 transform: translateY(-4px);
 box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(26,60,110,0.13);
 border-color: var(--accent);
 }

 .school-icon {
 width: 42px;
 height: 42px;
 border-radius: 11px;
 background: var(--tag-bg);
 display: flex;
 align-items: center;
 justify-content: center;
 flex-shrink: 0;
 }

 .school-icon svg {
 width: 22px;
 height: 22px;
 fill: none;
 stroke: var(--primary);
 stroke-width: 1.8;
 stroke-linecap: round;
 stroke-linejoin: round;
 }

 .school-name {
 font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
 font-size: 13.5px;
 font-weight: 700;
 color: var(--primary);
 line-height: 1.35;
 }

 .school-location {
 display: flex;
 align-items: center;
 gap: 5px;
 color: var(--text-sub);
 font-size: 12px;
 font-weight: 600;
 }

 .school-location svg {
 width: 12px;
 height: 12px;
 flex-shrink: 0;
 stroke: var(--accent);
 fill: none;
 stroke-width: 2.2;
 stroke-linecap: round;
 stroke-linejoin: round;
 }

 .installed-badge {
 display: inline-flex;
 align-items: center;
 gap: 5px;
 background: #e6f7f1;
 color: var(--success);
 font-size: 10.5px;
 font-weight: 700;
 padding: 3px 9px;
 border-radius: 20px;
 width: fit-content;
 }

 .installed-badge svg {
 width: 11px;
 height: 11px;
 stroke: var(--success);
 fill: none;
 stroke-width: 2.5;
 stroke-linecap: round;
 stroke-linejoin: round;
 }

 @media (max-width: 600px) {
 .schools-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
 .section-header h2 { font-size: 20px; }
 }
</style>
</head>

</div>

<div class="count-bar">

</div>

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: adminvivek
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://new.edumeasy.com.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

Transforming Government School Education

By establishing modern maths labs in government schools, we aim to make learning more interactive, practical, and engaging for students. item.title: Equipment
item.dc:creator: adminvivek
item.content:encoded:
Equipment

Math Lab Equipments for School

This Math Lab Equipments are going to make math easy and more results-oriented and students are going to love these types of equipment up to the level of understanding math easily. The Math Lab developed by IITians will bring revolution to the field of Math. The Math Lab is developed as per the syllabus of NCERT from classes 6th to 10th.

MA-01: ALGEBRA ANNOTATOR

The biggest challenge in learning Algebra is understanding the operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of the variables and functions of the variables. The Algebra annotator is designed for learning by visualizing and doing activities involving variables. This is one of the finest math lab equipment and model for Algebra.

Class – 6

Chapters, Algebra

Class – 7

Chapters, Simple Equation, Algebraic expressions, Exponents and Powers

Class – 8

Chapters, Linear equation in one variable, Algebraic Expressions, Exponents and Powers, Factorisation

Class – 9

Chapters, Polynomial, Probability

MA-02: NUMBER SYSTEM

A positive or a negative outcome is always a problem in using operations between Numbers. This operator helps in learning the concept by doing the experiments. This equipment helps in understanding the ascending & descending orders & various closer property

 

Class – 6

Chapters, Whole Numbers, Integers

Class – 7

Chapters, Integers

MA-03: GEOMETRY EXPOSITOR

Bothered about understating the statements and proofs of theorems! No worries, this one piece of equipment is the solution bank of all Geometrical concepts. Starting from understating the angles between two lines to visualizing the properties of parallel lines and triangles, this single equipment is loaded with a number of activities to excite the students. This equipment is it even serves the purpose of learning trigonometry.    

Class – 6

Basic geometry idea, Understanding of elementary shapes, Symmetry, Practical geometry

Class – 7

Lines and angles, Congruence of triangles, Practical geometry, Symmetry

Class – 8

Quadrilaterals

Class – 9

Introduction to euclid’s geometry, Lines and angles, Triangles, Quadrilaterals

Class – 10

Triangles, Introduction to trigonometry

MA-04: CO-ORDINATE SYSTEM DEMONSTRATOR

The basis of Co-ordinate Geometry is the coordinate system. For understanding the different quadrants and coordinates in a two-dimensional plane, this system demonstrates several different properties to visualize Co-ordinate Geometry. It helps in understanding the solutions of equations, roots of polynomials etc. 

Class – 6

Chapters, Prime and composite number, Decimals, Ratio and Proportion

Class – 7

Chapters, Rational Numbers

Class – 8

Chapters, Rational numbers, Square and square roots, Cube and cube roots, Direct and Inverse proportion

Class – 9

Chapters, Number system, Co-ordinate geometry, Linear Equation in two variables

Class – 10

Chapters, Real numbers, Polynomials, Pair of equations, Quadratic equation, Arithmetic Progression, Co-ordinate geometry, Statistics

MA-05: CIRCLE DESCRIPTOR

It starts and ends at the same point. The circle is one of the most beautiful geometrical figures which has several good characteristics. However, understating the properties and theorems is a herculean task. The descriptor is designed for doing some experiments for learning the Circle in a linear manner. The descriptor is also useful in learning fractions & elementary probability. 

Class – 7

Chapters, Comparing quantities

Class – 8

Chapters, Comparing quantities

Class – 9

Chapters, Circles

Class – 10

Chapters, Circles, Area Related to Circle, Probability

MA-06: MENSURATION EVALUATOR

Measurement of the area & volume of solids is one of the most interesting exercises in Mathematics if understood properly. The evaluator will help the teacher to demonstrate the concepts and will also help the students to learn the concepts by doing some hands-on. This math lab equipment is named as mensuration evaluator. 

Class – 6

Chapters, Playing with numbers, Data Handling

Class – 7

Chapters, Data handling, Perimeter and area,

item.content:encoded:
About

EduMEasy: A Comprehensive Math-Lab for Schools

Math Lab Introduction — Watch Now

Making Math Engaging, Interactive & Real

EduMEasy has developed a comprehensive Math-Lab for Schools to visualize and understand mathematical concepts through experiments. Our aim is to provide a one-stop solution for students to understand & apply math concepts in real time — combining theory, applications, and experiments.

EduMEasy Math Lab for Schools has a delightful workshop for every student who faces difficulty in Math. It adds surplus to the studies and will have a remarkable impact on the learning experience — helping to visualize every concept of mathematics and making learning easy.

Visualization and experimentation are two important aspects of teaching mathematics. There is a saying:

— A picture is worth 1000 words, if one is aware of its scope.

— A picture is worth 1000 words, if one is able to use it flexibly.

50% Students afraid of maths 100% NCERT syllabus covered IIT Jodhpur faculty & alumni

Math Lab Concept

Researchers observed that understanding patterns and visualization helps a student learn even complex mathematics and apply them to new problems. The team from IIT Jodhpur (faculty members & alumni) who conceived and developed this Math Lab are convinced that this lab provides a platform for teachers to teach the theoretical and abstract concepts of mathematics through experiments and visualizations — accompanied by study material for reflective thinking.

Almost 50% of students are afraid of maths. Math is the highest-scoring subject in every competitive exam, but a better score can only be secured with the help of the best faculty — which is practically impossible in most cases. Keeping this in mind, EduMEasy has made equipment for the Maths Lab which helps students learn math in a better and more joyful manner.

This equipment is going to make math easy, more results-oriented, and students are going to love learning up to the level of understanding math easily. Concepts and colors both matter — and this Math Lab designed & developed by IITians will bring revolution to the field of Math. This Math Lab is designed to cover the entire NCERT Syllabus.

Book a Free Demo Contact Us EduMEasy — Mathematics Laboratory

Where Mathematics
Comes Alive

A place to experiment, explore, and discover — through games, puzzles, and hands-on activities that ignite a lifelong love for mathematics in every student.

What is a Math Lab?

A Mathematics Laboratory is a place where anybody can experiment and explore patterns and ideas. It houses a rich collection of games, puzzles, and teaching-learning materials. The Math Lab provides students the opportunity to discover the "learning by doing" method — where many activities present a problem or challenge, with the possibility of generating further challenges and problems.

The activities help students to visualize, manipulate, and reason. They provide an opportunity to make conjectures and test them, and generalize observed patterns. They create a context for students to attempt to prove their conjectures. The Math Lab is a place to enjoy mathematics through informal exploration — a space where anyone can generate problems and struggle to get an answer.

Often the Math Lab takes students' knowledge beyond the curriculum. It is a self-directed space with activities where students can come anytime and engage in work, continue on problems and tasks, and use teachers only when they are stuck. In this way, the role of the teacher is not to instruct how to progress — but to facilitate inquiry with the mathematics within it.

Need & Purpose for Schools

  • Provides an opportunity for students to understand and internalize basic mathematical concepts through concrete objects and situations.
  • Enables students to verify or discover geometrical properties and facts using hands-on expositors.
  • Helps students to build interest and confidence in learning mathematics.
  • Exhibits the relatedness of mathematical concepts with everyday life, making the subject meaningful.
  • Provides greater scope for individual participation and becoming autonomous, self-directed learners.
  • Encourages students to think, discuss with peers and teachers, and assimilate concepts more effectively.
  • Enables teachers to demonstrate and reinforce abstract ideas using models, charts, graphs, and pictures.

How it Benefits Students

🔬

Hands-On Discovery

Concrete objects and real situations help students deeply internalize abstract mathematical concepts through direct experience.

📐

Geometry & Proofs

Students verify and discover geometrical properties through direct, physical exploration — making abstract proofs tangible.

💡

Confidence Building

A safe, exploratory environment grows genuine interest and lasting confidence in the subject for every learner.

🌍

Real-World Connect

Activities reveal how mathematics is woven into everyday life — making the subject relevant, purposeful, and engaging.

🤝

Collaborative Thinking

Students discuss and build ideas together with peers and teachers, assimilating concepts far more effectively than solo study.

🎯

Autonomous Learners

Greater individual participation helps students become independent, self-driven thinkers who take ownership of their learning.

Objectives of the Mathematics Laboratory

01

Provide readily accessible rich manipulative materials to emphasize learning by doing.

02

Develop an attitude of inquiry and curiosity in every student.

03

Remove the weaknesses of present-day mathematics education.

04

Develop much-needed confidence in students and a positive relationship with maths.

05

Generate genuine interest and enthusiasm for the subject.

06

Make students divergent thinkers who look for patterns and ask bold questions.

Our Achievements & Recognition

120+Govt. Schools ₹65L+Grants Secured Top 75Tech for Impact

Recognized by IITs, IIM Ahmedabad, the Government of Rajasthan, and leading CSR organizations for innovation and impact in experiential mathematics education.

Received ₹50 Lakhs funding from iHub Drishti Foundation, IIT Jodhpur to scale curriculum-aligned Math Lab solutions nationwide.

Secured a ₹15 Lakhs Grant from Kotak BizLabs under the prestigious IIMA Ventures program, recognizing innovative approach in EdTech.

Successfully established Math Labs in 120 government schools across Rajsamand in collaboration with the Government of Rajasthan.

Signed an MoU with the Rajasthan School Education Department for pilot implementation of Math Labs in government schools.

Selected among the Top 75 Technologies for Social Impact in India by IIT Delhi (Unnat Bharat Abhiyan).

Awarded 2nd Rank in Tech4Seva under Aatma Nirbhar Bharat at IIT Jodhpur.

Secured grant support from IIM Ahmedabad in recognition of innovation and impact in experiential mathematics learning.

Awarded grant support by the Government of Rajasthan for contributing to foundational learning and NEP 2020 implementation.

MoU signed between RScSE (Dept. of School Education) and EduMEasy on 23rd August 2022 for pilot in 11 schools of Jodhpur.

Collaborated with Eklava Foundation, Indeed Foundation, and Saura Urja on CSR-driven projects to expand quality math education.

Collaborated with Surya Urja and JSW, installing Math Labs in Phalodi, Nagaur, and Nagpur's tribal area schools with the Maharashtra government.

Published "Math Lab: Learning Math by Doing Math" in the research journal IIT Jodhpur TechScape.

Key Milestones & Participations

  • Registered with i-Start and incubated by IIT Jodhpur.
  • EduMEasy Maths Lab selected for the best snippets of IIT Jodhpur.
  • Presented Math Lab equipment to Hon. Shri Ashok Gehlot, CM of Rajasthan and Hon. Dr. B.D. Kalla, Education Minister, Rajasthan.
  • Participated in Padharo IIT 2022 and 2023 at IIT Jodhpur.
  • Participated in the IIS University 8th Rajasthan Science Congress Summit, October 2021.
  • Presented Math Lab at Chenpura School with Indeed NGO and RSS Adarsh Vidhya Mandir Group.
  • Installed Math Lab at Shantikunj Haridwar, inaugurated by Dr. Chinmay Pandya.
  • Installed Math Lab and kits at Kendriya Vidyalaya IIT Jodhpur.
  • Represented EduMEasy at DIDAC India.

Partner With Us

We look forward to working with esteemed institutions and supporting efforts in maximizing the field of education. We are confident we can meet the challenges ahead and stand ready to deliver effective, world-changing innovation in mathematics education.

If you have any questions or require assistance, we're here to support all your school Math Lab needs.
