Our team

Our team is dedicated, skilled, and united by a shared vision of success. Together, we work collaboratively to innovate, solve problems, and drive the company forward.

Dr. Vivek Vijay

Associate Professor


Department of Mathematics
IIT Jodhpur




Mentor & Director

Vivek Vijay is a passionate educator and Associate Professor of Mathematics at IIT Jodhpur. As the Director and Mentor of Edumeasy, he combines his academic expertise and leadership to make education engaging and accessible for students worldwide. His vision drives the creation of innovative tools and resources, transforming how students learn and interact with mathematics.

Dr. Sandeep Yadav

Associate Professor


Department of Electrical Engineering
IIT Jodhpur




Mentor & Director

Sandeep Kumar Yadav is an Associate Professor at the Indian Institute of Technology, Jodhpur, with a distinguished academic and research background. His expertise spans Signal Processing (Acoustic and Vibration), Condition Monitoring, Artificial Neural Networks, Blind Source Separation, Image Processing, and Machine Learning. As a Mentor and Director at Edumeasy, he leverages his rich experience and innovative approach to develop transformative educational tools that empower students to excel in mathematics and beyond.

Vivek Sahu

CEO & Founder

Vivek Kumar Sahu is the visionary CEO and Founder of Edumeasy, dedicated to revolutionizing the way students learn mathematics. A postgraduate in Mathematics from IIT Jodhpur, he combines his academic excellence with a passion for innovation to create engaging, hands-on learning tools. His leadership drives Edumeasy's mission to make mathematics accessible, interactive, and enjoyable for learners of all ages.

Sunil Kumar

Chief Operating Officer

Sunil Kumar is the Chief Operating Officer of Edumeasy, responsible for overseeing daily operations and optimizing business processes. With extensive experience in operations management, he drives efficiency and ensures smooth execution of strategies. Sunil’s leadership contributes to the company’s growth and operational success.

7 Equipment that covers the chapters from NCERT books of class 6th to class 10th

By EduMEasy

Hassel Free Online Support​

07.
Certificate of EduMEasy Lab School Partners​
By EduMEasy

Big Sized Equipments for better explanation​
By EduMEasy

item.content:encoded:
Install EduMEasy "Math Lab" anywhere in India for your School

Install "Math Lab" in Your School & Improve Student Math Scores Today...!

(As per CBSE Norms: from Class 6th to 10th”)

Attention Educators and Administrators! Give your students a cutting-edge advantage in math education with our revolutionary Math Lab for School. ALGEBRA ANNOTATOR​

The biggest challenge in learning Algebra is understanding the operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of the variables and functions of the variables. The Algebra annotator is designed for learning by visualizing and doing activities involving variables. This is one of the finest math lab equipment and model for Algebra.

NUMBER SYSTEM

A positive or a negative outcome is always a problem in using operations between Numbers. This operator helps in learning the concept by doing the experiments. This equipment helps in understanding the ascending & descending orders & various closer property

GEOMETRY EXPOSITOR Bothered about understating the statements and proofs of theorems! No worries, this one piece of equipment is the solution bank of all Geometrical concepts. Starting from understating the angles between two lines to visualizing the properties of parallel lines and triangles, this single equipment is loaded with a number of activities to excite the students. This equipment is it even serves the purpose of learning trigonometry. CO-ORDINATE SYSTEM

The basis of Co-ordinate Geometry is the coordinate system. It helps in understanding the solutions of equations, roots of polynomials etc.

About

EduMEasy: A Comprehensive Math-Lab for Schools

EduMEasy has developed a comprehensive Math-Lab for Schools to visualize and understand mathematics concepts through experiments. Our aim is to provide a one-stop solution for students to understand & apply math concepts in real-time & our approach is to make math engaging, & interactive by combining theory, application, and experiments. As we all know only the Physics, Chemistry, and Biological lab are, but EduMEasy has developed the Math Lab for students, in this, students will teach math with practical. EduMEasy Math Lab for School has a delightful workshop for every student who faces difficulty in Math and this ads surplus to the studies and also will have a remarkable impact on the learning experience of thousands of students. It helps to visualize a concept of mathematics by understanding the concepts and makes learning easy. Visualization and experimentation are two important aspects of teaching mathematics. In their paper, Rosken and Rolka (2006) concluded that – A picture is worth 1000 words if one is aware of its scope. – A picture is worth 1000 words if one is able to use it flexibly. Researchers observed that understanding patterns and visualization helps a student learn even complex mathematics and apply them to new problems. The team from IIT Jodhpur (professors & alumni) who conceived and developed this Math Lab are convinced that this lab provides a platform for teachers to teach the theoretical/abstract concepts of mathematics through experiments and visualizations. It is accompanied by study material for reflective thinking to regular reference by the experiments. Almost 50% of students are afraid of maths. Math is the most scoring subject in competitive exams like JEE. But a better score can only be secured with the help of the best faculty which is practically impossible in most cases. Keeping these things in mind, EduMEasy has made the equipment for Maths Lab which will help students to learn math in a better and more joyful manner. This equipment is going to make math easy and more results Oriented and students are going to love this equipment so they will be able to understand math easily. This equipment is very useful and colorful too. Concepts and colors both matter. This Math Lab foe schools designed & developed by IITians will bring revolution to the field of Math. Available Math Lab equipment from 6th to 10th class as per NCERT base. So Contact EduMEasy to solve this problem with its Math Lab for Schools to establish Math Lab in Schools. https://youtu.be/yRQdbj-vXUghttps://youtu.be/VrdaxypXTrg

What is math lab & Why is useful for students?

A mathematics laboratory is a place where anybody can experiment and explore patterns and ideas. It is a place where one can find a collection of games, puzzles, and other teaching and learning material. The maths lab provides an opportunity for the students to discover mathematics through doing. Many of the activities present a problem or a challenge, with the possibility of generating further challenges and problems. The activities help students to visualize, manipulate, and reason. They provide an opportunity to make conjectures and test them, and generalize observed patterns. They create a context for students to attempt to prove their conjectures. Mathematics laboratory is a place to enjoy mathematics through informal exploration. It is a place where anyone can generate problems and struggle to get an answer. It is a space to explore and design new mathematical activities. So, the maths lab should not be used to assess students’ knowledge of mathematics. Often mathematics lab takes students’ knowledge beyond the curriculum. The Mathematics laboratory is a self-explanatory lab with activities, in which students could come anytime (free to them) and engage in the work, continue working on the problems/tasks, and use teachers as and when they are stuck. In this way, the role of the teacher is not to teach how to progress in the activity but to facilitate inquiry with the mathematics in it. NEED AND PURPOSE: Some of the ways in which a Mathematics Laboratory can contribute to the learning of the subject are:
  • It provides an opportunity for students to understand and internalize basic mathematical concepts through concrete objects and situations.
  • It enables the students to verify or discover several geometrical properties and facts using models or paper-cutting and folding techniques.
  • It helps the students to build interest and confidence in learning the subject. The laboratory provides an opportunity to exhibit the relatedness of mathematical concepts with everyday life.
  • It provides greater scope for individual participation in the process of learning and becoming autonomous learners.
  • The laboratory allows and encourages the students to think, and discuss with each other and the teacher, and assimilate the concepts in a more effective manner.
  • It enables the teacher to demonstrate, explain and reinforce abstract mathematical ideas by using concrete objects, models, charts, graphs, pictures, etc..
  • It provides an opportunity to understand and internalize basic mathematical concepts through concrete objects and situations.
  • It enables the students to verify or discover several geometrical properties and facts using models or paper-cutting and folding techniques.
  • It helps the students to build interest and confidence in learning the subject.
  • The laboratory provides an opportunity to exhibit the relatedness of mathematical concepts with everyday life.
  • It provides greater scope for individual participation in the process of learning and becoming autonomous learners.
  • It provides scope for greater involvement of both the mind and the hand which facilitates cognition.
  • The laboratory allows and encourages students to think, and discuss with each other and the teacher and assimilate the concepts in a more effective manner.
  • It enables the teacher to demonstrate, explain and reinforce abstract mathematical ideas by using concrete objects, models, charts, graphs, pictures, posters, etc.
Objectives of Mathematics Laboratory
  • To provide readily accessible rich manipulative materials to emphasis on “learning by doing”.
  • To develop an attitude of inquiry.
  • Remove the weakness of present-day mathematics education.
  • To develop much-needed confidence in students.
  • To generate interest in the subject.
  • To make the students divergent thinkers.
  • To make the children look for patterns and ask questions.

Elevate Admissions with Our Transformative Math Lab: A Game-Changer for Schools

Introduction: As the education landscape becomes increasingly competitive, schools are constantly seeking innovative ways to attract students and stand out from the crowd. One powerful solution that has been proven to increase admissions is the establishment of a cutting-edge math lab. In this blog post, we will explore how schools can enhance their appeal and elevate admissions by incorporating our transformative math lab into their educational infrastructure. Join us as we delve into the myriad benefits and opportunities that a math lab can offer to schools and their prospective students. Emphasizing the Advantages: Introducing a math lab in a school setting opens up a world of advantages. By establishing a math lab, schools can provide students with a hands-on, interactive learning environment that breathes new life into mathematics education. The lab nurtures a deep understanding of mathematical concepts, stimulates critical thinking, and fosters problem-solving skills, leading to improved academic performance and heightened engagement. Tailoring the Math Lab to Your School: Our math lab is designed to be flexible and customizable, allowing schools to tailor it to their unique requirements and curriculum. Whether it's primary, secondary, or higher education, our math lab can be adapted to suit the specific needs of students and teachers. The lab becomes a dynamic hub where students can explore mathematical principles through a range of activities, experiments, and simulations. Showcasing Success Stories: Real success stories act as powerful testimonials that showcase the positive impact of a math lab. By highlighting the achievements and progress of students who have experienced our math lab, schools can demonstrate tangible results. Sharing these success stories will resonate with parents and students, fostering confidence in the effectiveness of the math lab and compelling them to choose a school equipped with this transformative resource. Differentiating Your School: In an increasingly competitive educational landscape, setting your school apart is crucial. A math lab becomes a unique selling point that distinguishes your institution from others. Parents and students are drawn to schools that offer innovative and forward-thinking educational resources. By establishing a math lab, your school showcases its commitment to providing an exceptional learning experience that prepares students for future success. Collaboration and Partnerships: Collaborating with other educational institutions and local organizations can further enhance the appeal of a math lab. By partnering with neighboring schools, you can offer access to your math lab resources and share best practices. Additionally, collaborations with community organizations, such as hosting math competitions or workshops, can showcase your school's commitment to educational excellence and create valuable networking opportunities. Supporting Teachers: The implementation of a math lab goes hand in hand with empowering teachers. Provide professional development opportunities, training sessions, and workshops to equip teachers with the knowledge and skills to effectively utilize the math lab. By investing in your teachers, you ensure the successful integration of the lab into the curriculum and maximize its potential for student engagement and achievement. Showcasing the Math Lab Experience: Organize open house events and school tours to offer prospective parents and students an up-close and personal experience with the math lab. Arrange interactive demonstrations, allowing visitors to participate in math activities, and witness the excitement and enthusiasm generated by the lab. Such experiences leave a lasting impression, making your school a top choice for parents seeking an innovative math education for their children. Conclusion: Establishing a math lab in your school can be a transformative step towards increasing admissions and enhancing the overall educational experience. By offering a dynamic learning environment that fosters critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and a genuine passion for mathematics, your school becomes an attractive destination for students and parents alike. As the education landscape evolves, embracing innovative resources like our math lab positions your school as a leader in delivering exceptional math education. Elevate your admissions, empower your students, and unlock the potential of mathematics with our transformative math lab. Note: Ensure that you personalize the blog by incorporating specific details about your math lab, its features, success stories, and the benefits it can bring to schools and students.

Introduction: In the fast-paced world of education, it is essential to equip students with the necessary tools to excel in their academic journey. Mathematics, being a fundamental subject, plays a pivotal role in shaping a student's cognitive abilities. The Need for an Innovative Math Learning Solution like Math Lab:

Mathematics education has traditionally been perceived as challenging and abstract, leaving many students feeling overwhelmed. This difficulty in understanding math not only affects their academic performance but also hampers their confidence and enthusiasm for the subject. Recognizing these challenges, the EduMEasy designed & developed Math Lab to revolutionize math education by providing a practical, hands-on learning experience that fosters comprehension and engagement.

Our aim is to make this cutting-edge solution accessible to schools of all sizes, ensuring that every student can benefit from an enhanced math learning experience.

In conclusion, the EduMEasy Math Lab is an innovative tool that can revolutionize math education in schools. It provides an engaging and interactive learning experience for students, improves academic performance, and enhances student engagement. The EduMEasy Math Lab is also affordable and easy to implement, making it an excellent option for schools that want to provide effective math education to their students, to Embrace the future of math education by installing.
FAQs of Math Lab:
1. Is the EduMEasy Math Lab suitable for students of all grade levels? No, it is available from 6th to 10th classes, the EduMEasy Math Lab is designed to cater to students from elementary to school. It offers a range of modules and activities that can be customized according to the grade level and curriculum requirements. 2. How long does it take to install and set up the EduMEasy Math Lab? The installation and setup process for the EduMEasy Math Lab can vary depending on the size of the school and the infrastructure in place. Our team will work closely with you to ensure a smooth and efficient implementation. 3. Can the EduMEasy Math Lab be integrated with our existing curriculum? Absolutely! The EduMEasy Math Lab is designed to complement and enhance your existing math curriculum. It provides a supplementary learning resource that aligns with the curriculum objectives and helps students develop a deeper understanding of mathematical concepts. 4. Comprehensive training will be provided to teachers, including workshops, webinars, and ongoing support to ensure they are well-prepared to utilize the lab effectively. 5. Our team will be delighted to arrange a personalized demonstration and address any specific questions or concerns you may have. 6. How does the EduMEasy Math Lab improve student engagement? The EduMEasy Math Lab provides an interactive and engaging learning experience for students, which helps to enhance their motivation and interest in math. 7. What kind of support does EduMEasy provide for schools that install the EduMEasy Math Lab? EduMEasy provides ongoing support and training to schools that install the Math Lab, ensuring that they can make the most out of this innovative tool. 8. Is the EduMEasy Math Lab affordable for small schools? Yes, the EduMEasy Math Lab is affordable and provides value for money, making it an accessible option for schools of all sizes. Math Lab Material List for Schools

Equipping the Future: Essential Math Lab Materials for Schools by EduMEasy

These are Math Lab Equipments (Total 6 - Eco-Friendly Hardware & not required electricity) that will be set up in your school by our team. All equipment used Iron metal for this lab. Their equipments are going to make math easy and more results-oriented and students are going to love them up to the level of understanding math easily. Brief details of equipment & accessories are following.

1) ALGEBRA ANNOTATOR:

The biggest challenge in learning Algebra is understanding the operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of the variables and functions of the variables. The Algebra annotator is designed for learning by visualizing and doing activities involving variables. This is one of the finest math lab equipment and model for Algebra.

This algebra annotator math lab equipment covers the following chapters, class wise which is an aid in teaching and learning math & the given accessories that will be provided by EduMEasy.

Covering Algebra Chapters with Classes:
  • Class 6 - Algebra
  • Class 7 - Simple Equation, Algebraic expressions, Exponents and Powers
  • Class 8 - Linear equation in one variable, Algebraic Expressions, Exponents and Powers, Factorisation
  • Class 9 - Polynomial, Probability

NOTE: We'll provide class-wise Study Manuals from classes 6th to 9th in Hindi & English Language.

Accessories that will be provided with Algebra Annotator:
  • Size: 3 ft x 3 ft in a square shape
  • Square plates Qty - 68 nos.
  • Rectangular Qty - 08 nos.
  • Balance (Traju) Qty -01 nos.
  • Allen key Qty - 01 nos.
  • Tripod Stand Qty - 01 nos.
  • Tray for holding Plates Qty - 01 nos.

2) NUMBER SYSTEM:

A positive or a negative outcome is always a problem in using operations between Numbers. This operator helps in learning the concept by doing the experiments. This equipment helps in understanding the ascending & descending orders & various closer property

This number system math lab equipment covers the following chapters, class wise which is an aid in teaching and learning math & the given accessories that will be provided by EduMEasy.

Covering Number System chapters with classes:
  • Class 6 - Whole Numbers, Integers
  • Class 7 - Integers

NOTE: We'll provide class-wise Study Manuals from classes 6th & 7th in Hindi & English Language.

Accessories that will be provided with Number System:

Interactive Learning Station

Primary Lab

Our Primary Math Lab equips young minds with the tools to understand and enjoy mathematics. With interactive learning tools, students can explore math concepts through hands-on activities and fun experiments.

Book Now

Key Features

  • Interactive Tools
    Instruments like Multiplicator, Pattern Finder, and Decimal Operator.
  • Hands-On Learning:
    Practical activities that connect theory with real-world applications.
  • Child-Friendly Design:
    Safe, durable, and age-appropriate for young learners.

Equipments

Multiplicator

The Multiplicator Instrument is an innovative and interactive tool designed to help students understand the fundamentals of multiplication, including the sense of positive and negative numbers. This instrument bridges abstract mathematical concepts with tangible, hands-on experiences, making the learning engaging and intuitive.

Shape Discriminator

The Shape Discriminator Instrument is an engaging educational tool designed to help students explore and understand geometric figures, their fractional properties, and the operations related to fractions. This instrument fosters a hands-on approach to learning, making the concepts of geometry and fractions more visible and interactive.

Time and Angle Tracker

The Time and Angle Tracker Instrument is a versatile and interactive educational tool designed to help students understand the concepts of time, angles, and properties of angles. By combining hands-on exploration with visual aids, this instrument simplifies complex ideas and fosters a deeper understanding of time measurement and geometric angles.

Decimal Operator

The Decimal Operator Instrument is an innovative educational toolkit designed to help students understand decimal place values, solve place value problems, and perform measurements of given figures. This instrument combines interactive learning with practical applications, making decimal concepts clear and engaging.

Pattern Finder

The Pattern Finder Instrument is a fun and engaging math tool designed to explore and solve matching problems by identifying and analyzing patterns. Through hands-on activities, it encourages critical thinking, boosts problem-solving skills, and helps children develop a strong understanding of patterns in a playful and engaging way. This instrument makes learning math exciting and relatable, fostering curiosity and creativity in young learners.

Mensurator

The Mensurator Instrument is a versatile educational tool designed to help students explore and understand a wide range of mathematical concepts, including the perimeter and area of various shapes, inequalities, and fundamental operations like division, multiplication, factors, HCF, and LCM. This hands-on instrument is perfect for enhancing problem-solving skills and building a strong foundation in geometry and arithmetic.

Number Interactor

The Number Interactor is an engaging educational tool designed to help students understand and solve problems involving addition, subtraction, and inequalities through hands-on activities. This instrument simplifies foundational arithmetic concepts, making learning interactive, fun, and practical for learners.

Number Twistor

The Number Twistor Instrument is an interactive educational tool designed to help students explore and identify even numbers, odd numbers, prime numbers, and divisors of various numbers through hands-on activities. This instrument brings fundamental number concepts to life in a fun and engaging way, allowing students to visualize and understand these key mathematical ideas.

Maths Lab Manuals

Comprehensive user manuals and activity guides to help teachers and students maximize the learning experience.

Interactive Tutorials

Step-by-step tutorials and hands-on examples designed to make learning engaging and practical for students of all levels

Technical Support & FAQs

Quick access to troubleshooting guides, common questions, and expert assistance to ensure a seamless experience with our tools and resources.

News and Coverage

Recognized for its innovative approach to teaching mathematics, our Primary Math Lab is making waves in educational communities.

Our team of experts

With decades of proven experience, our team is prepared to help you achieve your goals, and beyond.
